title: Design: Vendor invoice due date for a day-of-month term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A}, due on day 10 of the following month.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-32 Tenth.
  • {Vendor-A} is on {Term-A}.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-32 Vendor.
  • {Vendor-A} has a saved vendor invoice, {Vendor-invoice-A}, dated Oct 5, 2026.
    For example: {Vendor-invoice-A} is a vendor invoice for one part.
  • Starting screen: the vendor invoices list (Parts, Vendors, Vendor Invoices).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png, ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open {Vendor-invoice-A}.
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Vendor Invoice card shows "Invoice date" Oct 5, 2026 and under it "Due date" Nov 10, 2026, in the same layout as today's card (compare ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png and today's ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png; the yellow highlight on the picture is not part of the screen).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11676 (Story 7, Due dates)

  • S7-R2: “A "day of the following month" term is always due in the month after the invoice date, whatever the day of the invoice: with day 10, an invoice dated Oct 5 and one dated Oct 28 are both due Nov 10.”
  • S7-R9: “A vendor invoice stores no term. Its due date is calculated by the same rules from the vendor's term when the vendor invoice is created, recalculated when its invoice date or its vendor changes, and stored.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "7 Vendors" ("A vendor invoice today (Net 60)", "Vendor on 10th of next month: Oct 5, due Nov 10"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p7-09-a-vendor-invoice-today-net-60.png
  • ct-p7-10-vendor-on-10th-of-next-month-oct-5-due-nov-10.png

The design's own words:

  • “Same date rule as customer invoices: always the 10th of the next month; a shorter month uses its last day.”
  • “The highlight marks what to check; it is not part of the screen.”
